purpose: Audit receipt of exact parent-authorized correction implementing existing user basic-statistics direction; not a new governing instruction.
before: Do not convert SD, SEM, confidence intervals or untyped error bars into one another, count technical repetitions as independent experiments, or count repeated representations as new evidence.
after: Do not interchange SD, SEM, confidence intervals or untyped error bars. Convert them only when the required statistical information and assumptions support the calculation. Do not count technical repetitions as independent experiments or repeated representations as new evidence.
rationale: Old wording prohibited justified SD-to-SE arithmetic; current user permits appropriate basic statistical analysis. Preserve uncertainty meanings while permitting calculations with their required inputs and assumptions. Other parent TASK text unchanged.
